admin.intro:
Fix problems with the shared data here: edit fields (you can lock a field so automatic reports no longer overwrite it), block bad contributions, merge duplicate items, and ban instances that spam data.
Every change is recalculated from the remaining log immediately, so "hiding one bad value" never requires manually rolling back other fields.

sources.caveats: This page lays two known rough edges out in the open instead of hiding them. First, several instances may sit behind one source key (the same NAT egress plus the same client version get merged into a single source), which is why an "IP count > 1" above hints at that sharing. Second, an instance that changes IP drops into a different source and its historical weight does not follow it — in other words, the evidence below is not guaranteed to come from the same device.
sources.empty: No source has reported anything yet.
sources.feedbackEmpty: This source has not received feedback yet, so its weight stays at the baseline
sources.feedbackHint: Every piece of feedback is a manual judgement, and the weight is accumulated from exactly those judgements: upvotes raise it, downvotes lower it.
sources.heading: Reporting sources
sources.intro: Weight is recalculated automatically from feedback evidence (upvotes raise it, downvotes lower it). Admins can override it by hand, but the next piece of feedback for that source overwrites the override.
sources.ipTooltip: Several IPs have appeared behind this source key: multiple instances may share the same egress
sources.manualWeightHint: The baseline is {baseline}. A manually set value is only a temporary override: the next time feedback from this source arrives, the automatic recalculation overwrites it. To make it stick, lock the fields or block the relevant contributions instead.
sources.missingHint: The source key "{key}" is not in the weight table: it may have been purged, or the key in the link may have been altered.
sources.noEvidence: This source has not left any evidence yet
sources.recentHint: The server returns only the latest 100 entries, ordered from newest observation to oldest — which is why there is no pagination here.
sources.suspiciousHint: Suspicious = weight below the baseline of {baseline}. This is a temporary view filter for the UI (the server deliberately defines "suspicious" here instead of in the API, so the threshold follows the configuration).
sources.title: Reporting sources
sources.weightInvalid: Weight must be a number between 0 and 5
sources.weightSaved: Weight set to {weight}. Note that a manual value is only a temporary override: the next time feedback from this source arrives, it will be overwritten by the automatic recalculation.

upstream.title: Upstream Database
upstream.intro: Periodically upload every item that **has a barcode** to the upstream database. Here you can see whether each one was sent, whether it was received, and the full payload that "sending it again right now" would produce.
upstream.introNoBarcode: Items without a barcode are not uploaded — the upstream database identifies items by barcode, so there is nothing to match on.
upstream.transportOffHint: COLLECTOR_SYNC_TRANSPORT=off, so the collector only serves the pull-export API and never pushes. Set it to http or file and restart to enable.
upstream.intervalManualHint: A transport is configured, but COLLECTOR_SYNC_INTERVAL_MINUTES=0, so there is no scheduled job — you can only run a round here by hand.
upstream.tokenMissingHint: With COLLECTOR_SYNC_TOKEN empty the export and push APIs refuse outright — an open full export would treat the intranet as a security boundary.
upstream.runSkippedHint: Skipped items are those whose payload has not changed since the last success. Tick force resend to send them again.
upstream.runNotConfigured: No transport is configured, so this round sent nothing.
upstream.noItemsHint: Only items with a barcode get uploaded. Add a barcode in the correction console, or wait for instances to report.
upstream.resetHint: For when the content has not changed but the peer says it never arrived or deleted it. Only touches the sync ledger, never the data.
upstream.resetMissing: This item has no sync record yet
upstream.detailHint: This is the full content that sending **right now** would produce. It goes through the same builder as a real send, so the preview cannot drift from reality.
upstream.payloadEmpty: This item currently produces no payload (it may have lost its barcode or been merged)
upstream.syncMissing: This item has no sync record yet
